hlido_opinion.body: Proxy (Convergence AI) currently presents a vague offering with insufficient details to evaluate its capabilities effectively. The lack of verifiable claims or substantial information on its functionality raises concerns about its reliability and applicability in the AI agent space. While it holds a STEADY tier, this reflects more on the absence of negative indicators rather than any strong positive attributes. Potential users may find better-defined alternatives in the market. Without clear use cases or documented success, it is difficult to recommend this agent confidently.
